classification_taxonomy:
quarantine (rejected observations are never
    inserted into the store; the run fails visibly).
  - per-cycle and per-symbol latency recorded in the snapshot store.
  - ops/last_cycle_result.json consumed by the Actions step summary and the
    monitoring worker heartbeat.
  - report tree redirectable via TASK108_T107_DIR / TASK108_SNAP_DB so error
    injection tests never touch real artifacts.

eod.note: quote price equals the session daily close for matched symbols; the provider publishes no final-candle completeness flag, so completeness follows the data itself

real_failures_observed.handling: runs stayed RED, root-caused (deps, paths, bun, dirty-tree rebase, lock) — never masked as success
repo git-safety audit gate rejected git rebase in workflows; sync redesigned ff-only/merge; gate now 0 violations

unexpected_error_never_success: task107_monitor.main() maps unexpected exceptions to failed_internal_error exit 4; workflow summary renderer fails when no cycle result exists
degraded_vs_failed: degraded_provider keeps the run green WITH ::warning:: banner (retryable); integrity/config/internal failures are red
